content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NEPA Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 01-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NEPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the NEPA Recruitment 2026 is 01 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Company Secretary Management Trainee and CMA Trainee posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for these positions, with 2 for Company Secretary Management Trainee and 1 for CMA Trainee.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the CMA Trainee post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the CMA Trainee post, candidates must have passed the CMA Intermediate Examination conducted by ICMAI and possess a valid registration with ICMAI.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for these trainee positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for both Company Secretary Management Trainee and CMA Trainee posts will receive a stipend of Rs. 7,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for NEPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications for this recruitment must be submitted via email. Ensure all required documents are attached and the subject line is correctly mentioned.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for NEPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for NEPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve scrutiny of applications, followed by a written test and/or skill test, and a personal interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification PDF for NEPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section on this page, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these NEPA trainee positions?
faq.answer: The positions of Company Secretary Management Trainee and CMA Trainee are contractual in nature.

faq.question: Q10. Which state and city is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for National Newsprint and Paper Mills located in Nepanagar, Madhya Pradesh.
